_README: TEMPLATE ONLY — contains no real credentials. To enable cloud mode, copy this to 'cloud-creds.local.json' (same folder) and fill in your real V380 account. 'cloud-creds.local.json' is git-ignored (matches *.local.json) and is the ONLY file the app reads for credentials. Never put real credentials in this .example file, in chat, or in any committed file.
username: YOUR_V380_LOGIN (the phone number, email, or username you log in to V380 Pro with)
